Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and indication label 'prostate cancer'. Join drug_indication on mesh_heading or efo_term matching 'prostate cancer'. Join molecule_dictionary for chembl_id and pref_name. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
